b: I need to tell you properly about Sapa… The most beautiful place we went… After seeing us, one of our friends set off to Vietnam too… But she wasn't lucky enough to go to Sapa… Even if you see a thousand places, none of them is equal to one Sapa (let her stomach burn)

Whether it was our luck or what, the very next month there was a big storm.. Sapa was hit very badly, apparently.. Lots of destruction… Like Kerala, this too is God's own country… That's why the disasters come more often too.. It made me sad to think about it… I trust the people and Sapa will recover

Vietnam's highest mountain peak is in Sapa… It's called Fansipan.. All round it they've built a park like a Buddhist monastery…For that too you have to go by cable car… Take the cable car to the mountaintop and it's heaven itself…

I've always liked the film Sachien… Mountains, mist and snow, so beautiful… I've wanted to go to a place like that for many days … That mountaintop was a place like that..( In Sachien even the airport is full of mist… I should bring that art director here)

You can't walk in slippers… All the steps are terribly slippery.. We walked in shoes.. Listening to beautiful statues all around, soft music and all, we came to an enormous Buddha statue…. They finished this enormous place in 800 days.. I don't know how they brought all these statues up to this height and set them up .. made entirely of metal…

Looking at that, we came to the flagpole at the top of the mountain.. That's the highest point in Vietnam .. Many people took photos holding their countries' flags… We didn't see our lion flag .. Now if you hear our story and go, they'll put it up
After that we saw another standing Buddha, and left that heaven at leisure.. We went to the room, took off our shoes and clothes, dried them with a dryer and went to bed
The next day, a motorbike journey
note: The storm was probably Typhoon Yagi, which struck northern Vietnam in September 2024. Sachien (2005) is a Tamil film starring Vijay, set in misty hill country. The lion flag is the flag of Sri Lanka.
